body.x: Polar(www.polar.com) announced Polar Loop at 'Showstoppers' of 'CES 2014', the biggest IT∙appliances show held in Las Vegas, U.S. from January 7th to 10th.

Polar Loop registers your daily activity at different intensity levels continuously for 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, showing your resting and sitting time as well as daily activities at low, medium, and high intensities. This is also counts daily calories and steps, and tells you how much you need to do to reach the global recommendations for physical activity with practical guidance such as, ‘walk for 50 minutes or jog for 20 minutes’.

In addition, it has waterproof for swimming, provides custom-fit bracelet, and gives data transfer via custom USB cable or Bluetooth or Polar Flow mobile App. And this has 12 days memory capacity and rechargeable battery with 5 days continuous use.

'CES 2014(The International Consumer Electronics Show)' is owned and produced by the Consumer Electronics Association (CEA), the technology trade association. CES showcases 2,500 ~ 3,200 exhibitors in every kind of electronic appliance. More than 152,000 attendees from more than 150 countries come to the show.
